suggestions.title: Repair the garbled Chinese skill file from today’s prompt-clarification thread
suggestions.description: The only local project artifact created from today’s Codex thread is `clarify-and-optimize-prompt/SKILL.md`, and most of its Chinese body is mojibake-corrupted while `agents/openai.yaml` is readable. Codex can reconstruct the intended Chinese workflow from the thread and leave you with a usable skill immediately.
suggestions.prompt: Repair `clarify-and-optimize-prompt/SKILL.md` by restoring the Chinese content from the skill spec in today’s thread, keeping the existing frontmatter and structure intact, and then verify that the wording matches `agents/openai.yaml`.
